items.title: Higher direct images along a limit of morphisms, for a coefficient complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma generalises the companion limit result to coefficients in a bounded below complex: the higher direct images of the pullback of K_0 along the limit morphism are the colimits of the pullbacks of the corresponding higher direct images at finite stages (statement lines 7876-7887, whose notation is fixed by the companion statement delivered as a context span from lines 7566-7582). The proof reduces to the sheaf case by passing to the cohomology sheaves of a bounded below representative (proof lines 7889-7905), applies the companion statement sheaf by sheaf (proof lines 7905-7920) and reassembles the result (proof lines 7920-7928). The non-formal content is the passage from sheaves to complexes through the truncations. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of the companion result.
